findings.title: Israeli strike kills boy in Gaza as Qataris say vessel struck in Gulf, and other Mideast news
findings.affected_population_system: AP attributes to Shifa Hospital that one of the previously recorded three killed in the Gaza City strike was a 4-year-old boy and that a woman was seriously wounded. Reuters' photo caption independently identifies a boy, Zain Owais, and his father Mohammed as killed in an Israeli strike in Gaza City on November 1; the caption does not establish the boy's age. These are additional casualty and identification details about the already counted strike, not additional fatalities or a new attack.
findings.exact_supporting_passage: Another strike in Gaza City killed three people, including the boy, and seriously wounded a woman, according to Shifa Hospital
findings.source_type: Established news agency article directly accessible and citing Shifa Hospital; Reuters contemporaneous photo caption provides victim-identification context
findings.confidence: High for traceability of attributed hospital account and Reuters photo caption; the exact AP revision time is unknown, victim details not independently verified, and no additional death is counted.

bounded_discovery_context.newly_verified: Prior watch could not directly open the AP article and excluded an unverified age detail. This watch successfully opened AP and verified age four and a seriously wounded woman attributed to Shifa Hospital; Reuters directly accessible image caption names Zain Owais and father Mohammed in Gaza City.
bounded_discovery_context.secondary_source_passage: Funeral of Palestinian boy Zain Owais and his father Mohammed, who were killed in an Israeli strike
bounded_discovery_context.last_watch_coverage: Prior watch already recorded three killed near Taj Mall, Gaza City, and five killed in western Khan Younis, identifying the five as police officers based on Gaza interior ministry. Do not double count.
bounded_discovery_context.new_within_hour_unproven: AP article is dated November 1 but exact initial publication and revision times are not shown. This qualifies as newly verified follow-up evidence, not a newly timed strike.
bounded_discovery_context.corroboration_limits: Reuters photo caption establishes names and father-son relationship; the AP report establishes boy's age without naming the boy. Association between the two reports is plausible but not formally proven by both articles.
bounded_discovery_context.production_status: Supplementary discovery only; no editorial approval or public publication.
